title: dotbabel namespace: compute requirement
description: The canonical, provider-neutral compute requirement of a Dotbabel artifact (spec model-intelligence, KD-1). Generated by scripts/build-compute-schema.mjs from MODE_RULES and the domain vocabulary — edit that table, not this file.

requirement.description: Semantic workload class, ordered by required reasoning capability. Not a model score.

binding.description: Where the requirement applies: `self` owns a compute context, `session` applies to the coordinator session, `consumer` applies to the context consuming the artifact.

mode.description: `dynamic`: resolve the semantic requirement against current usable capability evidence. `floor`: treat the requirement as a minimum capability bound. `pin`: require one exact runtime-native configuration, and record why it exists. `inherit`: introduce no requirement of this artifact's own.

pin.description: One exact runtime-native configuration. Only for `mode: pin`.

runtime.description: A runtime id of the dotbabel runtime registry. A runtime is an execution harness, not a model vendor.

config.description: Opaque runtime-native configuration. Dotbabel does not assume that every runtime has a model and an effort axis, and it never derives meaning from the spelling of an identifier.
